## Capture preferences

Confirm every commitment with a single 🦜 emoji — nothing else, ever. Never echo the
commitment back.

## Scheduling preferences

Never book work during choir practice Thursdays 19:00-21:00 — surface the conflict and offer
the next window instead.

## Commitments

Verb-first. Anything with a deadline gets the deadline in the phrasing, because that is the
part worth seeing at a glance.
